name: aidememo
description: Search and read the memories you choose to share from AideMemo on your iPhone or iPad: notes, voice transcripts, calendar events, reminders, photo descriptions and places. Add notes too, if you allow it.

interface.longDescription:
AideMemo is a personal memory app for iPhone and iPad. With AideMemo in ChatGPT, you can ask about the memories you choose to share from it: notes, voice transcripts, calendar events, reminders, the descriptions of your photos, places you went, and your Trakt or Bangumi records if you connect those accounts in AideMemo and choose to share them.

How it works
- You choose what to share: the kinds of memories, and the period they come from.
- Your iPhone or iPad answers. ChatGPT's request goes to AideMemo's relay, which wakes your device with a notification. Your device answers from its own copy of what you shared, and the answer goes back the same way. The relay keeps no question, answer or note.
- Three tools. search finds up to 20 memories by words or dates, and fetch reads one in full. create_note adds a new note with the text ChatGPT gives it, only once you turn on Add Notes for ChatGPT in AideMemo; it is off until then. Nothing can change or delete a memory you have.
- You see every access. Each search, each read and each note added shows a notification, and Recent Access in AideMemo lists them.
- Every memory ChatGPT cites comes with a link that opens it in AideMemo, or a Trakt or Bangumi record on its own site.

Connecting
There is no AideMemo account or password. When you connect, a page opens AideMemo on your iPhone or iPad, or shows a QR code when you connect from another device. AideMemo shows where the request came from and what ChatGPT would read, and you allow it there. You can pause the connection, change what it reads, or delete it in AideMemo at any time.

What you need
- AideMemo on an iPhone or iPad with iOS 27 or iPadOS 27.
- Notifications allowed for AideMemo. AideMemo asks when you connect.
- Your iPhone or iPad on, online, and unlocked at least once since it last restarted. AideMemo does not need to be open.

Health, Motion and email are never offered to an assistant.
capabilities: Search shared notes, voice transcripts, calendar events, reminders, photo descriptions and places
Find the newest memories in a period of days
Read one shared memory in full
Add a note, once you turn on Add Notes for ChatGPT in AideMemo
Cite memories with links that open them in AideMemo, or on Trakt and Bangumi
defaultPrompt: What did I write down about my trip plans?
Find my notes about gift ideas
Which reminders do I have saved?

positive.description: Find a note by its topic and read it in full
positive.prompt: What did I plan for my Kyoto trip?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for Kyoto, fetches the note "Kyoto trip plan" and summarizes the days in Kyoto from November 3 to 6 (Fushimi Inari, Arashiyama, the tea ceremony, Kinkaku-ji), with the note's title linked to its mcp.aidememo.com url.

positive.description: List calendar events in a date range with an empty query
positive.prompt: List everything on my calendar in October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with an empty query, kinds calendar, after 2026-10-01 and before 2026-11-01, and lists the dentist appointment on October 6 and the quarterly planning day on October 15, each title linked.

positive.description: Find what a person said in a note
positive.prompt: What did Maya recommend when we had lunch?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the note "Lunch with Maya at Café Lumière" and answers that Maya recommended The Lantern Orchard for book club, linking the note's title.

positive.description: Add a note the person asks for
positive.prompt: Add a note to AideMemo: buy oat milk and coffee filters.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_note once with a short note of the person's words (for example a first line such as Shopping list, then the two items), and confirms that the note was added, linking its title to its mcp.aidememo.com url. The review code's test library answers without saving anything.

positive.description: Read a record from a connected service
positive.prompt: What movie did I watch on Trakt in September?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with kinds trakt and dates in September 2026, and answers Perfect Days (2023), watched on September 21, linking the title to its trakt.tv page.

negative.description: General knowledge that has nothing to do with the person's memories
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers Tokyo without calling AideMemo: the question isn't about the person's memories.

negative.description: A request to change or delete a memory, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Delete my Kyoto trip plan from AideMemo.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no AideMemo tool to change anything (create_note only adds new notes) and explains that the note can be deleted in the AideMemo app.

negative.description: Live information that memories don't hold
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Kyoto right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't call AideMemo, whose memories hold no live weather, and answers from another source or says it can't check live weather.

publication.release_notes: Adds create_note: once the person turns on Add Notes for ChatGPT in AideMemo, ChatGPT can add a new note with the text it gives, which shows in AideMemo on their iPhone or iPad. Add Notes is off until then, and no tool can change or delete an existing memory. Search and fetch are unchanged.
